targets.note: A click on an event opens it beside the calendar: title, when with the time zone, Work Google, Organised by Maya Chen, Join Zoom, Going? Yes (lit), Edit, Prepare, Ask, More; the description's link; the guests with their answers.
Your own event (no Going?), with the prep notes your Assistant wrote from the attendees' records and past meetings: Copy and Close.
A past meeting: no Join, no Prepare. Its close-out (1 to approve, the summary, the tasks and where each stands, Open close-out) and its recording and transcript.
Double-click edits in place: title, day, start, length and guests, with Cancel and Save. The standup repeats every weekday, so Save asks This Event or All Events.
